I'm on board with this minus the FOMO - the card being recurringly charged is passive; the credits should be, too, if this were implemented.

Normalize not requiring daily/weekly logins to Internet-based games and experiences.
This is exactly what I was thinking. Each month you should get awarded 100 credits when having vrc+, kinda like how Roblox premium rewards you robux each month for having premium
Really wanting a feature like this after the Shop implementation.

New EDM bundle is $53 AUD.

Can we please push this more? It's getting ridiculous.

details:
Throw in a small amount of VRChat Credits each month with VRC+. Doesn't have to be a crazy amount, just enough so it stacks over a longer period of time, so you can support a creator every now and then.

I think it would provide a range of positive outcomes:

- Increased value of VRC+.

- Player satisfaction.

- Creator satisfaction.

And most importantly imo:

- Boosted VRC Credits / Creator Economy awareness and usage.

Extra ideas:

- Award the Credits only for playing the game consecutively - achieving streaks for logging e.g. no less than weekly. This could balance it a little bit more, for the potential cash "lost" on giving the credits away.
title: Give VRChat Credits with VRC+
